meta.note: Type scale: ratio 1.25 from 16px, rounded (13, 16, 20, 31, 61, 76, 95). Spacing: 4-point grid. Inter with optical sizing. Oct 27 2026: matched to the design canvas (canvas wins on colour): faint yellow/blue glow and a yellow effort ramp; everything else black and white.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, value cards and the RPE card. No border; separated by tone only.

tokens.name: surface-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets such as the rest timer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and selected icons on bg and surface-card (17:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and unselected tab labels (5.2:1 on surface-card light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: icon-muted
tokens.usage: Greyed unselected tab icons; meets 3:1 for icons in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside list cards and above the set editor.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Empty tick rings, unset slider fill and step dots.

tokens.name: train-300
tokens.usage: Top stop of the glossy training gradient: graphite in Light, white in Dark.

tokens.name: train-500
tokens.usage: Training colour, now monochrome: Start button, set ticks, rest-timer bar, focus rings. Near-black in Light, near-white in Dark.

tokens.name: train-700
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the glossy training gradient.

tokens.name: train-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any training fill (white on near-black, near-black on near-white; 17:1).

tokens.name: wash-train-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the neutral grey wash at the top of training-day Home.

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Top stop of the glossy blue gradient.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Rest and recovery colour: rest-day action button, recovery dot.

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the glossy blue gradient.

tokens.name: wash-blue-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the blue colour wash at the top of rest-day Home.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Done and synced states: completed-day dot, synced badge.

tokens.name: danger-500
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and the offline badge.

tokens.name: rpe-6
tokens.usage: Effort slider fill at 6 (easy): the start of the yellow ramp.

tokens.name: rpe-7
tokens.usage: Effort fill at 7.

tokens.name: rpe-8
tokens.usage: Effort fill at 8.

tokens.name: rpe-9
tokens.usage: Effort fill at 9.

tokens.name: rpe-10
tokens.usage: Effort fill at 10 (max effort).

tokens.name: effort-word
tokens.usage: The effort word at RPE 9 and above, shown in bold (17:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted glass fill for the floating tab bar and pills; always with a 24px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: glass-menu
tokens.usage: Floating glass menus that pop from a pill (needs more opacity for legible rows).

tokens.name: lens
tokens.usage: Selected-row highlight inside glass: menu rows, routine selector.

tokens.name: lens-solid
tokens.usage: Solid fill of the gooey tab lens (the goo filter needs an opaque colour).

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Frosted stat tiles sitting on a colour wash.

tokens.name: black-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the glossy black button (flips to glossy white in dark).

tokens.name: black-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the glossy black button.

tokens.name: black-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the glossy black button.

tokens.name: yellow-500
tokens.usage: The only yellow in Tren: the effort slider and nothing else. Never a button or a fill behind text.

tokens.name: yellow-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a yellow fill, such as the number inside the effort slider (12:1 on yellow-500).

tokens.name: glow-train
tokens.usage: Top of the faint glow on training days; fades to bg by 62%. Decided Oct 2026: the canvas keeps this glow.

tokens.name: glow-rest
tokens.usage: Top of the faint glow on rest days; fades to bg by 62%.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Home hero number. One per screen.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Weight and reps in value cards.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Exercise name at the top of the live workout.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles, stat values, the RPE value in the slider.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, list names, the day tag.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text and captions next to a number.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gap: label to value, icon to text in chips, inset of a circle inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between tiles, cards in a row and small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps inside cards and between stacked rows in a section.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the default gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Large card padding and button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen side margins and space above a section title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top safe-area inset on phone screens.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom bar, primary buttons and the round action button.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small selectable rows and chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menu rows and the RPE slider track.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Stat tiles and the exercise thumbnail.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards: value cards, list cards, the RPE card, glass menus.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, the bottom bar, pills and every circle.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating buttons and the bottom bar. Always neutral grey, never tinted.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Edge of every glass surface: bright rim plus a soft lift.

tokens.name: shadow-gloss-train
tokens.usage: Glossy training action button (same gloss as the black button).

tokens.name: shadow-gloss-blue
tokens.usage: Glossy blue rest-day action button.

tokens.name: shadow-gloss-black
tokens.usage: Glossy black button (Log set, Finish, Skip).

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Small round controls on a card, such as − and +.
